title: Save AI Tokens: Stop Pasting Whole Files!
description:
Stop pasting whole files into your AI chat. 📎

✅ A pasted file can be 4000 characters
✅ Point to it with its path and an @ sign instead
✅ Count it in C#: 26 characters, not 4000

Day 7 of Token Saver! Next up, Day 8: Switch to a Cheaper Model.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to spend fewer tokens with AI.

#shorts #ai #claudecode #aitools #promptengineering #coding #learntocode #llm
comment: Paste or point: which do you do now? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: in Claude Code, type @ and start a file name to point at a file instead of pasting its contents.
